visualCharacteristics.purpose: Expandable labelled panels laid out as a grid of full-width triggers that open one panel below. Place in the section before the panel sections; each panel section needs Tab ID and Tab Title section metadata
visualCharacteristics.layout: Triggers laid out as a 2x2 grid of full-width rows with arrow icons and rules, opening the panel below (accordion-like) instead of a horizontal tab strip.

contentPattern.description: 4 expandable labelled panels, each with an optional subtitle and 3 image cards.
contentPattern.structure: Block table with only the block name (no rows needed). The following sections each carry section metadata Tab ID and Tab Title and hold the panel content (default content, cards-eyebrow)
contentPattern.notes: Panel content only enters the DOM after a trigger is clicked (absent from cleaned.html); the import must expand each trigger or read the rendered panels. Only 'Our latest insights' has a subtitle.

usage: Expandable labelled panels laid out as a grid of full-width triggers that open one panel below. Place in the section before the panel sections; each panel section needs Tab ID and Tab Title section metadata.
reuseGuidance: Use instead of tabs when the triggers should be a stacked grid that expands panels below rather than a horizontal tab strip.
